query: INSERT INTO family_members (id, family_id, user_id, display_name, role, permissions, relationship, joined_at, deleted_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, role = EXCLUDED.role, permissions = EXCLUDED.permissions, relationship = EXCLUDED.relationship, joined_at = EXCLUDED.joined_at, deleted_at = EXCLUDED.deleted_at
